1.4
Relationship to Protocols and Other Structures
RDL is used as a payload in the following protocols:
ReportExecution2005 [MS-RSWSRE2005]: Used when setting the definition of a report for

execution.
ReportService2005 [MS-RSWSRMNM2005]: Used when setting or retrieving the definition of a

report in the report catalog.
ReportService2006 [MS-RSWSRMSM2006]: Used when setting or retrieving the definition of a

report in the report catalog.
RDL references structures that are defined in [MS-RDLRS].
